text:
zoe: Heads up  spotted a flurry of 404 fragments after the docusaurus migration, mostly hitting guides with punctuation in headings (colons, emojis, backticks). Example: /guides/auth#two-factor-setup -> 404.

ishaan: saw that too. mkdocs produced `two-factor-setup` but docusaurus sometimes becomes `two-factor-setup-1` or collapses punctuation. linkcheck picked up ~12 misses.

marco: short-term fix: add explicit ids on problematic headings, e.g. `## Two-factor setup {#two-factor-setup}`. Long-term we should pick a slugification heuristic and document it.

docbot: buildkite/docs-validate #1201 failed: 12 missing fragments (exit=1).

zoe: i've opened a tiny PR that: 1) adds explicit ids to the 12 pages, 2) adds a linkcheck fixture test so CI builds the site and asserts the fragments exist; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123

ishaan: quick review note: prefer ids on the heading itself (not the preceding paragraph or code fence) and keep ids ASCII-only, hyphen-separated. Add a line in the contributor guide: "When headings include emoji, code, or punctuation, add an explicit id using ASCII kebab-case."

marco: also adding a small pre-commit md-lint hook to warn when heading contains non-ascii or inline code without an explicit `{#id}`. snippet: `git add -p && ./tools/markdown/check_heading_ids.sh`

zoe: ran local `yarn build && ./tools/linkcheck/check_fragments.sh build` and verified the fragments. marking PR ready for review.

docbot: buildkite/docs-validate #1203 succeeded: linkcheck passed.

ishaan: merged PR at 1823460025. leaving a follow-up issue to: (a) audit integrations pages for legacy mkdocs slugs, (b) add a short styleguide snippet + examples for explicit ids, and (c) add a test for emoji-in-heading regression.

marco: +1. i'll draft the styleguide paragraph and some copy-paste examples to reduce friction for contributors.

zoe: thanks everyone. small release-note line: "docs: stabilize heading anchors after docusaurus migration; require explicit header ids for headings with punctuation/emoji/code; add linkcheck fixture to catch regressions."

ishaan: :thumbsup: closing the loop.
